Puts MG4Control fully to sleep: no shortcuts (buttons regain their original function), no floating buttons or driver display modules, no profile applied at startup, no automation. Useful when leaving the car at a workshop without uninstalling the app. Your settings are kept and come back as soon as the mode is turned off.
Holding the right joystick’s centre click for 5 seconds opens MG4Control, even in Garage mode. Requires the accessibility service (advanced shortcuts).
In AUTO, the car sets the fan, the air direction and the recirculation itself. Untick what you want to keep under your control.
Always: that is what AUTO does.
All ticked = the car’s behaviour. Unticked: MG4Control puts your setting back right after AUTO turns on (HVAC pop-up, Climate page, profiles and A/C automation).
Keep the A/C off when the temperature changes

The car turns the A/C back on whenever the setpoint changes. If it was off, MG4Control turns it off again: from MG4Control, and on trial from the car’s screen. Never in AUTO or with the front defrost on.
Return to the default profile each time the car enters READY

By default, a profile chosen by hand stays in place until the car is switched off. With this option, it is forgotten each time the car enters READY, including after a short stop, and the default profile is applied again. If a profile tied to the outside temperature or to a Bluetooth phone should apply, it keeps priority, as at start-up.

Every time the lights switch on or off (tunnel, car park, nightfall). Adjusting brightness by hand pauses the automation until the next start.

Works with the light switch on AUTO: the automatic lights are what detect darkness. Without the “Adjust brightness while driving” box, the setting is made at start-up, then once when leaving a garage. Each change fades in over one second.
Adjust brightness while driving (not only at start-up)
The light is recalculated every minute; the screen is only readjusted when the gap reaches 10 points. Adjusting brightness by hand pauses the automation until the next start.
Use the lights switching on and off (brightness lowered in garages and tunnels, even in broad daylight)

The light is recalculated every minute; the screen is only readjusted when the gap reaches 10 points, and every time the lights switch on or off. Adjusting brightness by hand pauses the automation until the next start.

Outdoor light is estimated from the sun height and the Open-Meteo sunshine forecast (CC BY 4.0) over an area of about 60 × 60 km around the car, downloaded for 3 days and refreshed every 8 h at most or when leaving the area, with a position rounded to ~10 km. Without a forecast, a clear sky is assumed. Each change fades in over one second.

A single check, when the car starts (READY): if the threshold is not met at that moment, nothing triggers until the next full start of the car.

If the threshold is not met when the car starts (READY), the check is repeated each time the car enters READY again. As soon as it is met, the settings are applied once, then nothing more until the next full start of the car.
Each time the car enters READY

Switch off intelligent battery heating after a driving time

The countdown starts when heating is switched on, driving or parked (original screen, “low temperature” window, MG4Control or shortcut), or at start-up if it was already on. It only applies to the current trip: it is cancelled at the end of the trip, when the car leaves READY. A message is shown when heating is switched off.

MG4Control intercepts assigned buttons before the launcher.

A press that carries a shortcut replaces the button's original function. The others keep it: assign a double press to the Home button and a single press still returns to the MG launcher.

The only trade-off: on a button with a double press, the single press comes with a slight delay (0.3 s), the time needed to make sure no second press follows.

Everything returns to normal once the shortcut is deleted from Shortcut list.
Close the windows when leaving the car

Car in P, once armed by the conditions below: when the car leaves READY (seat belt unfastened and driver door opened, or car switched off), all windows close after the chosen delay. Going back to READY before then cancels.
No anti-pinch protection on windows other than the driver\'s: nobody near the windows when leaving.

How long the app drives the windows without a sensor, for a full open or close. The driver window keeps its own automatic travel. Too short, and the window stays ajar.
Measures each window\'s real travel, more accurate than the general time. Measurements are kept if you turn the option off.
The app cannot see the door switches: an emulated travel always runs for the measured time, whatever position the window started from.

Starts from the steering-wheel shortcut. Three modes, with the car left on and locked: pre-conditioning, dog mode and surveillance. The settings are chosen in its window, which always opens on “Now”. At the end, the climate goes back to the settings it had before.

Take the key and don’t lock with it: the car would switch off. Before getting out, switch the lights and wipers to OFF yourself. Never leave a child alone in the car; in dog mode, don’t stay away long: the climate can stop at any time (battery, fault).
